sanctions.legal_ref: Reference: Law n°92/007 of 14 August 1992 — Art. 30 (Disciplinary sanctions). Suspension: max 8 working days, mandatory IT notification within 48h.

sanctions.val_duration_max: Duration may not exceed 8 working days (Art. 30 of the Labour Code).
sanctions.val_description_lourde: Detailed reason for gross fault is mandatory.
sanctions.banner_avertissement: This sanction does not entail loss of salary (Art. 30 of the Labour Code). No notification to the Labour Inspector required.
sanctions.banner_blame: The reprimand does not entail loss of salary (Art. 30 of the Labour Code). No notification to the Labour Inspector required.
sanctions.banner_mise_a_pied: LEGAL OBLIGATION: Suspension must be notified to the Labour Inspector within 48 hours (Art. 30 al.3c of the Labour Code). Non-compliance → sanction null and void.
sanctions.banner_lic_grave: Serious fault: notice period and severance pay remain due to the employee.
sanctions.banner_lic_lourde: Gross fault: neither notice period nor severance pay are due (Art. 37 of the Labour Code). Detailed reason mandatory.
